name: hubdeckmail
description: Relay between a Cloudflare-hosted domain and a hosted HubDeck app (HubDeckMail protocol v1)

HUBDECK_URL.description: The HubDeck app's address, from Settings > Integrations, for example https://helpdesk.example.com

INTEGRATION_ID.description: The integration ID from Settings > Integrations

ALLOWED_SENDERS.description: Addresses this relay may send as, comma-separated; @example.com allows a whole domain

RELAY_SECRET.description: The relay secret from Settings > Integrations (shown once)
